title: Vibe Hobby: messy call, caller corrects the floor, gas smell

lines.text: Nine one one, what's the address of your emergency?
It's the office building on Gulf Freeway, by the Almeda exit, I don't know the number, there's smoke everywhere!
Sir, is it eighty eight sixty six Gulf Freeway?
Yes, yes, that one. The fire's on the second floor. No, wait, sorry, it's the third. It's the third floor.
Is everyone out of the building?
I think two people are still up there. Actually, one just came out. So one, my manager, he was in the hallway by the copy machine.
It smells like gas on the stairs. And the smoke is black, really black, coming from the left side.
Stay away from the building. Help is on the way.
